Package gui

Class TabWaitingListController

java.lang.Object
gui.TabWaitingListController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Initializable
public class TabWaitingListController extends Object implements Initializable
Controller for the Waiting List tab in the Restaurant Management UI. This class manages the display of customers currently waiting for a table and provides functionality for restaurant staff to view, refresh, and remove customers from the queue. It communicates with the ClientController to fetch and update waitlist data from the server.
